boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Trinity University
boards.description: Ten currently documented San Antonio food destinations with late availability, including an on-campus option.

cards.title: Coates Student Center
cards.subtitle: Trinity University campus
cards.notes: Use the student center for an on-campus food stop; confirm which individual dining counter is operating when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus building with dining options and documented midnight closing on select days.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity lists the Coates Student Center’s academic-year hours as until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and identifies the Commons Food Court there.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year building hours listed: Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–midnight; Sunday 10 a.m.–midnight. Individual vendors may differ.

cards.title: Barbaro
cards.subtitle: 2720 McCullough Ave, San Antonio
cards.notes: Plan a dinner or takeout stop on McCullough Avenue, and check the posted service details before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A Monte Vista pizza restaurant open until midnight every day under its posted schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Barbaro’s official site lists hours until 12 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Monday–Thursday 4 p.m.–12 a.m.; Friday–Sunday 11 a.m.–12 a.m.

cards.title: Pizza Classics
cards.subtitle: 3440 N Saint Marys St, San Antonio
cards.notes: Use the North Saint Mary’s location for a late pizza pickup; Friday and Saturday have the latest posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A nearby North Saint Mary’s pizza restaurant with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Classics’ official site lists Friday and Saturday hours through 12 a.m. at 3440 North Saint Marys Street.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Tank's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 902 N New Braunfels Ave, San Antonio
cards.notes: Order pickup or delivery from this N New Braunfels Avenue pizzeria; its official schedule extends latest on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant with documented 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Tank’s Pizza lists Friday and Saturday hours until 2 a.m. and offers pickup and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday 4 p.m.–2 a.m.; Saturday 4 p.m.–2 a.m.; other listed days close at midnight.

cards.entity_name: Urban Bricks Kitchen at McIntyre's North Star
cards.title: Urban Bricks at McIntyre's North Star
cards.subtitle: 90 NE Interstate 410 Loop, San Antonio
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s posted hours and order food from the Urban Bricks location at North Star before its late closing.
cards.short_summary: A pizza, pasta, and salad counter whose page lists 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday venue hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Urban Bricks’ McIntyre’s North Star page lists Thursday–Friday hours until 2 a.m. and Saturday hours until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Urban Bricks Kitchen at McIntyre's North Star
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Wednesday until 12 a.m., Thursday–Friday until 2 a.m., Saturday until 2 a.m., and Sunday until 12 a.m.; confirm food-service availability.

cards.title: Marco's Pizza on Babcock
cards.subtitle: 6563 Babcock Rd, San Antonio
cards.notes: Use online ordering or pickup at the Babcock Road store; the Friday and Saturday schedule is the latest listed.
cards.short_summary: A counter-service pizza location with documented 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Marco’s official Babcock Road location page lists store and online-ordering hours until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday 10:45 a.m.–3 a.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–3 a.m.; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 12 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Pizza Hut at 1820 S General McMullen Dr
cards.title: Pizza Hut on General McMullen
cards.subtitle: 1820 S General McMullen Dr, San Antonio
cards.notes: Use carryout or delivery for this location and choose a night matching the later posted weekend carryout schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Pizza Hut location with midnight carryout most nights and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday carryout.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official location page lists carryout hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut at 1820 S General McMullen Dr
cards.access_notes: Official carryout hours: 10 a.m.–12 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Delivery hours are listed separately and may vary.

cards.title: Denny's on Fredericksburg
cards.subtitle: 4510 Fredericksburg Rd, San Antonio
cards.notes: Use this Fredericksburg Road diner for a sit-down, takeout, or breakfast-at-any-time option; call ahead if plans change.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner location in San Antonio.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official San Antonio location finder lists the 4510 Fredericksburg Road restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The official city location page marks Denny’s at 4510 Fredericksburg Rd as “Open 24 Hours.”

cards.title: IHOP on West IH 10
cards.subtitle: 6031 West IH 10, San Antonio
cards.notes: Use the all-day restaurant for dine-in, curbside, takeout, or delivery and verify service availability for your planned arrival.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP with late-night food, takeout, and delivery options listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official page for 6031 West IH 10 lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies late-night food, dine-in, takeout, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday, with dine-in, curbside pickup, takeout, and delivery amenities.

cards.title: IHOP at 12780 W IH 10
cards.subtitle: 12780 W IH 10, San Antonio
cards.notes: Keep this W IH 10 location as a round-the-clock option; use its official ordering link or call before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A second 24-hour IHOP location with documented late-night food service.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official page for 12780 W IH 10 lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day and includes late-night food among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; dine-in, curbside pickup, online ordering, takeout, and delivery are listed.
